Convert to a simulated metacommunity

Source: R/evolving.R
as_metacommunity.Rd

Turns the output of simulate_evolving_metacommunity() into an mc_sim object, as from simulate_metacommunity(), with the extant species, their reconstructed tree and their traits (the mean genetic optimum over their populations), for as_mc_data(), summary_stats() and the other functions of the package.

Usage

as_metacommunity(x, ...)

Arguments

x

An mc_evolving object.

...

Unused.

Value

An mc_sim object.

See also

Other simulate metacommunities: colonisation_history(), evolution_control(), genetic_matrices(), growth_rates(), logistic_gradients(), maladaptation(), mc_dynamics(), persistence(), range_history(), simulate_evolving_metacommunity(), simulate_logistic(), simulate_metacommunity(), simulate_static(), speciation_control()

Examples

set.seed(1)
ls <- landscape_grid(5, disp_scale = 0.5)
ancestor <- data.frame(optimum = 50, sigma = 20, r_max = 5, row.names = "sp1")
sim <- simulate_evolving_metacommunity(ls, ancestor, dispersal = 0.002, n_steps = 300,
                                       speciation = speciation_control("geographic", 80))
as_metacommunity(sim)
#> <mc_sim> 25 sites x 86 species
#> species persisting: 86 of 86 
#> mean local richness: 6.4
